risks: Eval forward in PerplexityCallback.on_step_end (train.py:79) runs without torch.no_grad(); activations for backward are kept
Eval batch 32 is 8x the train batch
No sequence packing; batches are padded (longest)
Eval batch size 32 is 8x train batch size 4, risks OOM at first eval.
Perplexity callback runs model without torch.no_grad and stacks every loss tensor, keeping full autograd graphs alive through eval.
No packing with longest padding wastes about 46% of tokens and slows training.
Custom eval runs at step 200 outside Trainer eval, so Trainer eval_under_no_grad does not protect it.
